inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to conclude renegotiation of the 2009 agreement, threatening an indefinite nationwide strike if its demands are not met. Government should honour its obligations, but holding universities hostage is no way to resolve a dispute: students and families should not be made to bear the cost of a breakdown in negotiations. Both sides need to act responsibly and reach a settlement before another strike disrupts university life.
